d.d: Existing in or sunk to a low condition, position, or state; contemptible, despicable, miserable.

d.x: abject failure   abject nonsense   abject terror

d.d: Of a person: cast down in hope or spirit; showing utter helplessness, hopelessness, or resignation; also, grovelling; ingratiating; servile.
A person in the lowest and most despicable condition; an oppressed person; an outcast; also, such people as a class.
